ctx.x: And then in about a year or so, was this a summer vacation?

I really don't know whether it was summer vacation but I decided to go out and stay out, which I didn't. I had to come back and go to school again. I went to Cleveland and several other places and by that time John Williams had joined with a small combo and he won my mother's confidence. He was very smart. He really should have been a psychiatrist because the things he did to help Andy Kirk in the band, keeping him down dissenting and all that and making a guy play and do his instrument was really terrific.
How old was he when you first met him?
